message.content: {"caption":"A comparison of shopping-agent workflows shows how reasoning memory streamlines the search for an inexpensive, highly rated men’s shoe.","description":"The figure presents two horizontal workflows made from e-commerce screenshots. The upper workflow, labeled “Baseline (No memory),” shows a lengthy search in which the agent cannot filter by men’s shoes and must scroll; a red annotation highlights the inefficient navigation. It ends with a checkout action and a boxed total of 29 steps. The lower “Reasoning Bank” workflow shows the agent hovering over the Shoes and Men categories, selecting a price, and identifying a product with at least five reviews; a green memory hint explains the navigation strategy. It also ends with a checkout action, with a boxed total of 10 steps. Green checkmarks appear beside both checkout actions.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
